description:
Dig, discover and bring dinosaurs back to life!

Become the youngest member of the dig team in Dino Dig - Little Paleontologist. Brush away sand, shovel the soil, crack rocks with your hammer, melt ice and drill volcanic stone to uncover real-looking fossils. Clean every bone, rebuild the skeleton like a puzzle and switch on the DNA Light... ROAR! Your dinosaur wakes up and moves into your very own Dino Park.

500 LEVELS TO EXPLORE
- 10 worlds: Red Canyon, Jurassic Jungle, Blossom Plains, Deep Ocean, Cloud Cliffs, Ice Age, Golden Desert, Misty Forest, Volcano Island and the Lost Valley
- 50 species with their own colours, patterns and moves: T-Rex, Triceratops, Stegosaurus, Brachiosaurus, Velociraptor, Ankylosaurus, Spinosaurus, Pteranodon, Mosasaurus, Woolly Mammoth, Saber-toothed Cat and many more
- 6 digging tools and 6 kinds of layers, each with its own feel: brush, shovel, hammer, heat lamp, drill and blower

12 KINDS OF FUN
- Full fossil expeditions: dig, clean, assemble, revive
- Museum skeleton puzzles with tricky rotated and mixed-up bones
- Picture jigsaws, shadow matching and memory cards
- Egg hunts, egg hatching, feeding and bath time
- Dino runs and exciting escapes from rolling boulders, lava and avalanches

DINO PARK & DINO BOOK
- Every dinosaur you revive lives in your park: feed it, wash it, play with it
- Hatch eggs into cute baby dinosaurs
- Decorate the park with palms, waterfalls, crystals and a volcano
- Collect all 50 picture cards in the Dino Book with fun facts, sizes and diets
- A new surprise fossil every day

MADE FOR LITTLE HANDS
- No reading needed: a glowing hand shows what to do
- No time pressure, no failing - every child succeeds
- Bright, hand-crafted art and original music
- Plays offline after the first launch

FOR PARENTS
- Designed for children aged 3-8
- Over 350 levels in 7 worlds are free to play
- Optional Dino Dig Premium monthly subscription (all packs unlocked), a one-time Unlock All, or individual premium islands (Deep Ocean, Ice Age, Volcano Island)
- All purchases and settings are behind a parental gate
- We do not collect personal data

Subscription details: The Dino Dig Premium subscription unlocks all packs while active and renews monthly unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Microsoft account at confirmation of purchase. You can manage or cancel the subscription at account.microsoft.com/services.

Privacy Policy: https://mucobulut.github.io/oyunlar-destek/dinodig/privacy/
short: 500 dinosaur levels! Dig fossils, rebuild skeletons and wake 50 cute dinosaurs with the DNA Light, then care for them in your own Dino Park.
